name: Tickglint: ESP32-S3 Smart Clock
tagline: Alarms, timers, sun and moon and festivals on a 12864 LCD, with an Android app, a custom PCB and a browser flasher
description: Tickglint turns an ESP32-S3 and a 12864 (ST7920) LCD into a smart desk clock. It has four clock faces, a calendar, eight alarms with a buzzer (they ring without Wi-Fi or the phone), timer, stopwatch and pomodoro, four world clocks, sunrise, sunset and moon phase calculated offline, and birthdays and Indian festivals with confetti, sparkle and balloon popups. The Android app pairs over Bluetooth with a PIN shown on the LCD, sets the time from the phone and controls every setting. The firmware installs from this website in one click (web flasher), from the phone over USB-OTG, or with PlatformIO. A custom carrier PCB (KiCad, Gerbers and BOM included) and a colour-coded wiring diagram are part of the project.
features: Four clock faces: big digits, analog, flip and compact; 12/24 hour
Eight alarms with repeat days, snooze and buzzer, working with no Wi-Fi
Timer, stopwatch, pomodoro and hourly chime
Sunrise, sunset and moon phase from your city, calculated on the clock
Birthdays and Indian festivals (2026-2028) with animated popups and a countdown
World clocks, temperature and humidity (BME280), DS3231 RTC support
Android app: Bluetooth setup with a PIN on the LCD, every setting, demo mode, tutorial and guide
Install firmware three ways (web flasher, phone over USB-OTG, PlatformIO) on ESP32-S3, ESP32 and ESP32-C3 boards
Custom ESP32-S3 carrier PCB with backlight and buzzer drivers (fab files included)
Colour-coded wiring diagram (SVG), REST and Bluetooth API, OTA updates
